description: This file defines an interface for a builder to construct JsonParseOptions objects, allowing configuration such as URL decoding options.

classes.name: JsonParseOptionsBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining methods to configure and build JsonParseOptions instances.

methods.name: withUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to URL decode the JSON string to parse.

methods.name: withoutUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to NOT URL decode the JSON string to parse.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a new JsonParseOptions object with the configured options.
